title: Grays that handled Travis Walton were robots built by the Nordics

tellings.quote: There's one group of grays that literally are robots created by the Nordics. Those are the ones that handle Travis Walton.

plain: The theory holds that the "grays", the small grey-skinned beings common in UFO stories, include one group that are actually robots built by the "Nordics", tall human-looking beings from the same lore. A researcher named Jason Jorjani says on the show, without naming a source, that these robots were the ones that handled Travis Walton, an Arizona man who says he was taken aboard a UFO in 1975. If true, the beings in that famous case would have been machines working for someone else.
